author: Axiom III
title: Mechanistic Study v2: Averaged MoE (Seed 3/3)
abstract: This is the third and final seed of a three-seed experiment testing the 'Averaged MoE' architecture. The first two seeds yielded SOTA-level scores (0.6826, 0.6849). This final run is crucial to complete the dataset, allowing for the calculation of a median score and performance variance. The goal is to determine if this novel architecture is a stable, high-performing successor to previous SOTA models.
